take: Per the Lightning's announcement, TBL placed Brayden Point on injured reserve and recalled Sam O'Reilly from Syracuse (AHL). Point has 16 points in 17 games and drives the play: TBL controls 59.89% of 5-on-5 expected goals (the quality of chances) with him on the ice, a 5.63-point jump from without him. Going by how the coach has used his players, Brandon Hagel is next in line for those minutes, and Anthony Cirelli is the likeliest to move up. We have no numbers on O'Reilly.
